name: sessions
description: Side panel with this folder's sessions: status colors, sections, one-window switching, stop, restart, rename, a waiting-for-you filter, auto-pin and reopen with Remote Control, a notification when a session waits too long or spends far above its usual, spend and token usage, a status line, ccc tell and ccc section for scripts, and an API for other plugins

debugLogs.title: Debug logs for new sessions
debugLogs.description: Sessions the panel (n) or ccc create write Claude's debug log to ~/.claude/mods/sessions-data/debug/<name>.log, and the mod logs each step of its start there

waitPushMinutes.title: Notify me when a session has waited this many minutes
waitPushMinutes.description: Once a session of the project has waited this long for you (a question or a permission, or marked as needing you), you're notified once for that wait: on your phone with Remote Control, else through your notification channel. 0: never

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: No notifications in these local hours, written as 22-7 or 22:30-07:00. Empty: none

notificationsPerDay.title: Notifications a day, at most
notificationsPerDay.description: For all of the panel's notifications together. 0: none

staleMinutes.title: ⧗ after this many minutes
staleMinutes.description: A session working this long, or a background session done and unseen this long, gets a dim ⧗ before its time. 0: never
